title: Ext of module-valued sheaves computes pure Ext of the underlying modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an affine scheme U = Spec(A) and A-modules M and N, the lemma gives a canonical functorial isomorphism between Ext^i computed in all O-modules between the associated sheaves and the pure Ext groups Pext^i_A(M, N) (statement lines 2995-3002). The proof constructs the arrow from right to left by sending a pure injective resolution of N to the associated exact complex of adequate O-modules, which turns a pure Ext class into a map in the derived category; it then reduces the Ext group along all O-modules to the one computed in adequate modules via the comparison lemma, transfers the computation to the equivalent category of adequate functors, and identifies pure injective resolutions with injective resolutions there using the classification of injective adequate functors (proof lines 3005-3031). The level is H3: the construction and the two reductions are each displayed, with the equivalence of categories used at exactly the stated place.
